render_rays_coarse_and_fine: render rays through a NeRF scene using coarse and fine networks with volume or image mode sampling
volume_sampling_grid_features: sample 3D feature volumes at ray points using grid sampling with AABB normalization and boundary masking
sample_pdf_importance_sampling: perform importance sampling along rays by computing CDF from weights and inverting to select depth samples
raw2outputs_volume_rendering: convert raw NeRF network output to rendered RGB and depth maps using alpha compositing and transmittance
sample_along_camera_ray: sample 3D points along camera rays with uniform or inverse depth distribution and optional random perturbation
